subject: Next steps and trial scope proposal — Novaflow evaluation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@novaflow.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed trial scope — Novaflow evaluation

Hi Elena / Novaflow team,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciated the open discussion on search relevance and the ingestion pipeline. Below is a concise recap and a proposed trial (5-week) scope we discussed so your team can review and confirm. I attached a one-page scope doc for your internal circulation.

Call recap (high level):
- Goal: Reduce triage time for customer tickets by surfacing relevant KB articles and previous similar tickets.
- Key constraints: Sensitive PII redaction, on-prem connector to S3 ingestion, ~30k monthly documents indexed initially.
- Success signals: 20-30% reduction in average handle time for triage use case OR precision@5 > 0.7 on our eval set.

Proposed trial outline (5 weeks):
1) Week 0 (prep): data access & connector setup, confirm schema.
2) Week 1–3 (ingest + baseline): ingest sample 30k docs, run baseline retrieval+ranker with Redwood default config.
3) Week 4 (tuning): iterate ranking signals and prompt templates; run evaluation on your test set.
4) Week 5 (handoff): review results, recommend roadmap & cost/perf profile for production.

Owners / asks from Novaflow:
- Data engineering: S3 access to sample bucket (read-only)
- Security: brief SOC2/controls review (we can share our SOC2 summary)
- Product: 1–2 validation prompts and labeled test queries for success metric computation

Redwood owners:
- Kimberly Park (AE) — trial lead / commercial sync
- Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) — technical lead for ingestion & evaluation
- Vivek Kulkarni (CS) — success criteria & rollout planning

Attachments: Novaflow-Proposed-Trial-Scope.pdf (attachment stub)

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm the two success metrics you prefer (handle-time reduction vs precision)
- Share read-only S3 path and preferred kickoff date next week

Happy to iterate on the scope — I’ll follow up with Ben and Vivek to schedule the technical kickoff once you confirm.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Novaflow-Proposed-Trial-Scope.pdf, 118KB)
From: Elena Soto <elena@novaflow.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novaflow Procurement <procurement@novaflow.io>
Date: 2026-09-21T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed trial scope — Novaflow evaluation

Thanks Kimberly — useful summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Success metrics: Product prefers precision@5 on our labeled set as primary. Operations would like handle-time reduction as a secondary signal. We can prioritize precision for the trial.

2) Data access: We can provide a read-only S3 bucket and a small anonymized sample (5k docs) first — engineering to validate connector.

3) Compliance ask: Our procurement/security team will need a short SOC2 summary and data retention details before we sign the trial order form. Looping procurement on this email.

Elena Soto
Head of Product
Novaflow

Elena — appreciate the quick reply and the precision-first callout. A few technical notes and requests from my side before the kickoff: 

- Connector: we have an S3 ingestion workflow that supports prefix filtering and incremental syncs. We just need the read-only role/ARN and sample path to validate schema.
- Data format: JSONL or Parquet both work; if possible include a field marking redacted vs original text so we can verify redaction.
- Eval harness: If you can provide the labeled evaluation queries and ground-truth IDs as CSV (query_id, query_text, expected_doc_ids), we’ll compute precision@5 / recall numbers and share the notebook.

I attached our SOC2 summary for procurement to review — it covers scope, controls, and point-of-contact. Happy to do a quick compliance sync with your security team if needed.

Proposed technical kickoff windows next week: Tue 9/28 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 9/29 11:00–12:00 PT. Please confirm what works.

Ben Carter
